scoring_justification: The main results (Tc, κ_T, χ, η_s, η_B) are reported in CSVs; recomputing them from raw MC/MD trajectories is infeasible for the verdict, so we compare reported values to paper-reported reference values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for Tc, κ_T, χ, η_s, η_B from the paper's figures and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Subir K. Das et al., Phase Transitions 77, 823-834 (2004).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from Fig.1 (Tc=1.638), Fig.2 inset (κ_T values), Fig.3 inset (χ values), Fig.5 (η_s, η_B).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are read from the published paper's figures and explicitly quoted in the text where available.

outputs.description: Coexistence curve data and the fitted critical temperature T_c.
Isothermal compressibility κ_T and concentration susceptibility χ at the studied temperatures.
Shear viscosity η_s, bulk viscosity η_B, and their ratio η_B/η_s determined via Green-Kubo integrals.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are reported in Lennard-Jones reduced units. The checker compares the agent's reported values against the paper's published results with appropriate tolerances and also verifies qualitative trends (e.g., monotonic increase of η_B near coexistence, η_B/η_s > 2.5 at T=1.4).

steps.description: Check that the fitted critical temperature Tc is within 0.02 of the paper's value 1.638.
Check that κ_T and χ at each temperature are within 30% relative tolerance (or small absolute tol) of the paper's reference values.
Check that η_s, η_B, and ratio at each T are within 20% relative tolerance of paper values, and that η_B increases monotonically as T decreases.
